props.text: Import this project, then locate Gateway operations in Projects and open its Designer or operator link. Open Gateway Settings in Designer or Settings in Projects as an administrator to inspect the running gateway and resource counts.
Publish the project and open its operator link. Engineering and operator sign-ins appear as separate sessions. Use only a disposable session for the revocation exercise in the guide.

Open Diagnostics and compare automatic observations every 15 seconds while visible. Inspect process memory, available disk and bounded API records. Download the support JSON and verify that project contents and credentials are absent.

Open Deployment in Gateway Settings. Compare observed listeners, startup values and saved listener settings. Edit a local HTTP port, choose Validate draft, then Cancel changes. Validation and cancellation do not save or restart. Saving and recovery are separate exercises for a disposable gateway in the guide.
